summary: Magic Empire Global Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of CFO Yau Ting Tai on June 15, 2026, for personal reasons, effective immediately, with no disagreement noted. On June 17, 2026, the Board appointed Mei Wang, age 54, a 33-year banking veteran from Agricultural Bank of China (most recently President of Jinan Free Trade Zone Sub-branch), as CFO. No material terms, consideration, or advisor were mentioned. This is a routine executive leadership change with no structural or economic impact on shareholders. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report for a management change and does not involve a special situation.
